item.title: HackerOne platform down [resolved]
item.description:
Users unable to load pages or receive errors across the platform. All major endpoints were affected the GraphQL API, reports, and team pages.
Root Cause: AWS experienced a connectivity disruption impacting multiple services in us-west-2, including EC2, Internet Connectivity.

item.title: Cloudflare outage causing errors on www.hackerone.com [resolved]
item.description:
We experienced elevated errors on the marketing site and login paths due to a Cloudflare service outage. Our application infrastructure stayed healthy, but requests through Cloudflare failed during their incident.
No action was required on our systems. The issue resolved once Cloudflare restored normal operations.
